name: dsh-my-plugins

one_liner.zh: 在 DSH 顶栏查看并搜索当前 profile 已加载的插件清单。
one_liner.en: View and search the plugins loaded by the current DSH profile.

local: Reads the selected DSH profile and installed package metadata.
Records tool-call counts in a local JSON file.

readme_mismatch: README says the plugin does not access the network, but lib/index.js can fetch the registry from DSH_WEB_URL when configured.

completeness.reason: Inventory, search, refresh and usage summaries are implemented with fallback handling.

code.reason: Host scanning and UI are separated; errors are mostly contained, with no type annotations.

docs.reason: README explains installation, data sources, visible fields and limits.

maintenance.reason: 19 commits and a recent update on 2026-11-05.

tests.reason: Two smoke test files are present; CI is not configured.

quality.notes: C-lite review covered entry, client UI, bundle registration and host implementation.
